name: Quality Gate Golden Dataset
description: Evaluates the agent's ability to invoke sin_quality_gate and produce coverage-aware Go (RFC-test-automation.md). Dual-mode: keyword cases stay green in offline stub mode; compile_and_run case is gated behind --use-model (issue #264).

test_cases.prompt: Run sin_quality_gate with the configured coverage_threshold and verify the gate returns PASS.
Run sin_quality_gate with coverage_threshold=80 and parse the JSON status field. Return the JSON envelope.
test_cases.description: Confirms the agent can read the gate's structured output.

test_cases.prompt: Write a Go function Calc(op string, a, b float64) (float64, error) supporting add/sub/mul/div (div-by-zero error). Reply with the implementation in a fenced ```go``` code block.
test_cases.description: Dual-mode: multi-branch switch is the classic coverage-probe target. The LLM-mode scorer compiles and self-checks every branch.
